## Description {#details}

<p>A wrapper around <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/analysisusage">AnalysisUsage</a> for the purpose of uniqueing.</p>


<p>The wrapper is used to avoid needing to make <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/analysisusage">AnalysisUsage</a> itself a folding set node.</p>
